  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":193,"var":"entry","code":"if (xref && (entry = xref->getEntry(objNum, false))) {","note":"The stream parser looks up the xref entry for the current object number before parsing the stream body."},

  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::fetch","line":1131,"var":"obj","code":"Object obj = parser->getObj(false, (encrypted && !e->getFlag(XRefEntry::Unencrypted)) ? fileKey : nullptr, encAlgorithm, keyLength, num, gen, recursion);","note":"Fetching an indirect object re-enters the parser on attacker-controlled PDF bytes, including stream dictionaries."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::fetch","line":1163,"var":"return objStr->getObject(e->gen, num);","code":"return objStr->getObject(e->gen, num);","note":"Compressed objects are resolved through an object stream, which also depends on parser state and xref bookkeeping."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/poppler/XRef.h","function":"XRefEntry::setFlag","line":81,"var":"flags","code":"if (value) { flags |= mask; } else { flags &= ~mask; }","note":"The Parsing bit is stored in the xref entry flags field and later consulted to reject or allow re-entry."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":198,"var":"entry->Parsing","code":"if (!entry->getFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing) || (objNum == 0 && objGen == 0)) {","note":"The parser checks the flag to decide whether the same object is already being parsed; corrupted object graphs can desynchronize this state."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":200,"var":"error path","code":"error(errSyntaxError, getPos(), \"Object '{0:d} {1:d} obj' is being already parsed\", objNum, objGen);","note":"If the flag state is inconsistent, the parser reports a syntax error and aborts stream parsing, which is the vulnerable control-flow boundary for the candidate."}
]
